title: B-roll beside the speaker
caption: Motion B-roll timed to the speaker's words: two transparent card panels in the empty right side of the frame, never on the speaker, and one full-frame cutaway for the line about automation. The speaker is a synthetic figure and her voice is AI-generated with Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign, a designed voice not based on a real person.
prompt: Here is a 15-second talking-head clip of our presenter (work/source.mp4) and its captions (captions.srt). Add Magnifito motion B-roll to it, 1920x1080. She stands on the left, so put transparent panels in the empty right side and keep them off her face and off the burned-in captions. Use a card for “websites, social media, email and ads, all in one plan”, a full-frame cutaway for “then we automate the follow-up”, and a card for what happens to every new lead. Use our brand.json, take every row from what she says and do not invent any numbers. Render a review preview and a contact sheet, and check the sheet before you hand it over.
commands: mgvideo broll words captions.srt -o work/transcript.json --txt work/words.txt
mgvideo broll compose plan.json work/preview.mp4 --sheet work/contact.png
